"""Independently reopen the portable packet and verify exact runtime restoration."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import statistics
import struct
import tarfile

import join_common as c
import join_process as p
import join_reference as ref
import join_score

index_path = c.ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-join-membership-2026-10-07.json'
index = c.read(index_path)
archive = c.ROOT/index['archive']
assert c.sha(archive) == index['archive_sha256'] and archive.stat().st_size == index['archive_bytes']
payloads = {}
manifest = None
with tarfile.open(archive,'r:xz') as tar:
    for member in tar:
        assert member.isfile() and not member.name.startswith('/') and '..' not in Path(member.name).parts
        raw = tar.extractfile(member).read()
        if member.name == 'manifest.json':
            assert manifest is None and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == index['manifest_sha256']
            manifest = json.loads(raw)
        else:
            digest = member.name.removeprefix('files/')
            assert member.name == 'files/'+digest and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == digest
            assert digest not in payloads
            payloads[digest] = raw
assert len(payloads) == index['unique_payload_count']
assert len(manifest['paths']) == index['source_path_count']
assert set(payloads) == {item['sha256'] for item in manifest['paths'].values()}
for item in manifest['paths'].values():
    assert item['member'] == 'files/'+item['sha256'] and len(payloads[item['sha256']]) == item['bytes']


def data(name):
    return payloads[manifest['paths'][name]['sha256']]


def local(path):
    path = Path(path)
    if path.is_relative_to(c.OUT):
        return '$EXPERIMENT/'+str(path.relative_to(c.OUT))
    if path.is_relative_to(c.ROOT):
        return '$ROOT/'+str(path.relative_to(c.ROOT))
    return '$EXTERNAL/'+str(path).lstrip('/')


def value(name):
    return json.loads(data('$EXPERIMENT/'+name))


freeze = value('membership-screen-freeze-1.json')
summary = value('screen-1/summary.json')
decision = value('membership-analysis-1.json')
source = value('join-source-1.json')
for name,key in (('membership-screen-freeze-1.json','freeze_sha256'),
                 ('screen-1/summary.json','summary_sha256'),('membership-analysis-1.json','analysis_sha256'),
                 ('finalize_membership_drop.py','packet_driver_sha256')):
    assert hashlib.sha256(data('$EXPERIMENT/'+name)).hexdigest() == index[key]
for path,digest in freeze['helpers'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(data(local(path))).hexdigest() == digest
for module in (p,ref,join_score):
    assert c.sha(module.__file__) == freeze['helpers'][str(Path(module.__file__))]
assert len(source['source_hashes']) == 943 and len(source['baseline_source_hashes']) == 941
for name,digest in source['source_hashes'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(data('$EXPERIMENT/source-1/'+name)).hexdigest() == digest
for name in c.OWNED:
    assert hashlib.sha256(data('$EXPERIMENT/originals-1/'+name)).hexdigest() == source['baseline_source_hashes'][name]
assert summary['status'] == 'complete' and len(summary['records']) == 7
assert summary['reverse'] is False and summary['initial_identity'] == summary['final_identity']
cells = {}
for name,record in zip(freeze['cells'],summary['records'],strict=True):
    assert record['cell'] == name and record['reverse'] is False
    receipt = record['receipt']
    saved_bytes = data(local(receipt['path']))
    assert hashlib.sha256(saved_bytes).hexdigest() == receipt['sha256']
    saved = json.loads(saved_bytes)
    assert saved == {key:value for key,value in record.items() if key != 'receipt'}
    assert not saved['failed'] and saved['postcheck_errors'] == []
    for path,identity in saved['artifacts'].items():
        raw = data(local(path))
        assert len(raw) == identity['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == identity['sha256']
    stdout = next(path for path in saved['artifacts'] if path.endswith('.stdout.json'))
    raw = data(local(stdout)).decode()
    native = {tag:[json.loads(item) for item in re.findall(r'\b'+tag+r'\s+(\{[^\n]*\})',raw)] for tag in p.TAGS}
    assert native == saved['native']
    p.validate(native,'measure',freeze['fixtures'][name]['reference'])
    pairs = []
    for pair in native['MEMBERSHIP_PAIR']:
        members = {member['enabled']:member for member in pair['members']}
        pairs.append({'control_ns':sum(call['nanoseconds'] for call in members[False]['calls']),
                      'candidate_ns':sum(call['nanoseconds'] for call in members[True]['calls'])})
    cells[name] = pairs
    assert statistics.median(pair['candidate_ns']/pair['control_ns'] for pair in pairs) == decision['cell_ratios'][name]
score = join_score.score(cells)
assert score == index['score'] and all(decision[key] == item for key,item in score.items())
assert cells == decision['paired_complete_call_sums']
assert not score['complete_operation_gate_passes'] and not index['retained'] and not index['confirmation_run']
assert [item['cell'] for item in score['regressions']] == ['u64_half','u64_high']
for cell in ref.CELLS:
    fixture = freeze['fixtures'][cell.name]
    expected = data('$EXPERIMENT/fixtures-1/'+cell.name+'/expected.pairs')
    assert len(expected) == fixture['reference']['output_rows']*16
    assert hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest() == fixture['reference']['output_sha256_le_u64_pairs']
    actual_pairs = struct.iter_unpack('<QQ',expected)
    assert all(actual == wanted for actual,wanted in zip(actual_pairs,ref.expected_pairs(cell),strict=True))
validation = value('fixture-validation-1/summary.json')
assert len(validation['records']) == 14 and validation['status'] == 'complete_exact_validation'
assert not validation['performance_screen_samples_collected']

current = c.source_hashes()
assert current == source['baseline_source_hashes'] and len(current) == 941
assert c.identity(current) == source['baseline_identity_sha256'] == index['accepted_source_identity_sha256']
historical_identity = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(current,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
assert historical_identity == 'a7308b726410569306bae14bf60ddd07f57bead73d44d423f5274b5b17c10c5f'
assert all(not (c.ROOT/name).exists() for name in c.NEW)
guard = c.guard_receipt('membership-finalize-drop-guard-1')
proof = {'schema_version':'shardloom.join_membership_restoration.v1','status':'verified',
    'restored_source_assets':941,'restored_source_identity_sha256':c.identity(current),
    'identity_serialization':'Python json.dumps(source_hashes, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon))',
    'historical_builder_source_identity_sha256':historical_identity,
    'historical_identity_serialization':'Python json.dumps(source_hashes, sort_keys=True), default separators',
    'accepted_runtime':'53cd1582','source_commit':c.git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
    'existing_files_restored':{name:current[name] for name in c.OWNED},
    'candidate_only_files_removed':list(c.NEW),'decision_index_sha256':c.sha(index_path),
    'archive_sha256':c.sha(archive),'portable_unique_payloads_reopened':len(payloads),
    'portable_paths_verified':len(manifest['paths']),'all943_candidate_source_assets_verified':True,
    'all1050_timed_calls_revalidated_from_portable_stdout':True,'all7_complete_pair_oracles_regenerated':True,
    'finalization_guard':guard,'verifier_sha256':c.sha(Path(__file__)),
    'verifier_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'candidate_confirmation_run':False,
    'restoration_boundary':'Byte-for-byte restoration to the accepted runtime; no new runtime behavior or skipped candidate acceptance is promoted as retained.'}
target = c.ROOT/'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-join-membership-restoration-2026-10-07.json'
c.write(target,proof)
print(json.dumps({'status':'verified','restored_assets':941,'portable_paths':len(manifest['paths']),
                  'proof_sha256':c.sha(target)}),flush=True)
restoration_boundary: Byte-for-byte restoration to the accepted runtime; no new runtime behavior or skipped candidate acceptance is promoted as retained.
